description: Silent-pass defects in code this project did not write, each anchored to a real fix commit in the upstream repository. Ground truth is the upstream maintainers' own decision that the pre-fix behaviour was wrong, not our judgment.
status: INCOMPLETE — 7 of 17 candidates adjudicated (session limit). See papers/RESULT_sp_ext_interim_2026_08_21.md. Not a finished corpus; no gate has been applied.
inclusion_rule: R1 a reachable path existed where the measurement did not happen
R2 on that path the value was INDISTINGUISHABLE from a real healthy measurement
R3 the fix made the absence visible
adjudication: three independent reviewers per candidate, each assigned a distinct lens and each prompted to REJECT; accepted only when rejecters fail to reach a majority; uncertainty resolves to REJECT
recall: UNKNOWN. Candidates come from a frozen commit-message regex intersected with a frozen diff shape. Fixes described some other way are invisible to it. SP-EXT is a LOWER BOUND on incidence and must never be quoted as a rate.

cases.fix_subject: fix(checks)!: return None from SuiteResult.pass_rate when nothing evaluated (#2753)
cases.what_failed: the suite evaluated nothing — an empty suite, or every scenario skipped, or the producing probe crashed
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: the pre-fix DOCSTRING documented the flattering default as intended behaviour — '1.0 when all scenarios are skipped' — so a consumer reading 1.0 was reading the documented contract, and a suite that evaluated nothing was indistinguishable from one in which everything passed
cases.consumer: the Rich console summary line 'Summary: … | Pass Rate: 100.0%'; the Giskard Hub upload payload via to_hub_format/model_dump, which shipped 1.0 as a genuine success_rate; the project's own README example print(f'Aggregated pass rate: {results.pass_rate * 100}%'); and user CI gates thresholding the field
cases.fix: the zero-denominator branch returns None, the signature becomes float | None, the console renders '—' when None, and the Hub payload serialises the absence
cases.prefix_docstring: pass_rate : float — Fraction of non-skipped scenarios that passed (1.0 when all scenarios are skipped).
cases.consumer_evidence: confirmed by the fix's own diff: the README example was changed to handle None, tests/export/test_hub.py was extended (the Hub payload carried the value), and the garak scan adapter was updated — three distinct consumers touched by the one fix
cases.verification: read directly from git at dd75e974ee by the author of this entry, not taken from the adjudicating agents. An earlier draft of this record named the module as giskard/core/suite.py, which does not exist; corrected before publication.
